text: Right, the one thing i was reading through the file and wanted to also make sure you are aware of all the capability that lives inside of the '/compiled' route or when you run 'tools/rjit game play' since that is all no js already
resolution: Surveyed the compiled no-JS path (tools/rjit game play) per the user's pointer and confirmed framework/game/camera.zig (V23) is a complete host-owned orbit camera — Mode.orbit, solveOrbit, a Controller with per-frame solve+smoothing+distance-constraint and applyInputDeltas, binding a Scene3D.Camera node; gpu/3d.zig renders host-side. This means the Studio reuses the existing host camera (already driven by sculptCamera via GAME_CAMERA) rather than building a new one. Captured in MESH_EDITOR_PLAYBOOK.md build log + the project memory; it de-scoped Increment 2 so most of the first slice is hot-reloadable and only the wireframe render mode needs a rebuild.
